title: CASE #007: THE CIPHER CORRIDOR
briefing: A suspicious cross-district activity pattern has been detected across two regional rings. You do NOT have all the information. You have 10 Investigation Points to query phone registries, toll logs, and CDRs. Find the hidden bridge before points run out.

result.details: Outgoing encrypted calls observed right before highway transit. No direct call to Group 2 leader.
Over 19 unrelated civilian entities pinged this exact cell tower on the same evening. This is a deliberate false correlation!
Crossed Suryapet Toll at 23:30, bridging the transit gap between Guntur and Cyberabad convoys.
Direct 7-minute voice call with Person A (Guntur) at 22:43, followed by a 4-minute call to Person B (Cyberabad) at 01:12. Zero calls between A and B!
Group 1 vehicle leaves Guntur at 21:00. Person D meets midway at Suryapet at 23:30. Group 2 vehicle arrives Cyberabad at 02:00.
Person D (Vikram Rao) exhibits a betweenness centrality of 0.88, serving as the sole topological connector between the two otherwise disjoint rings.
Do NOT trust high-frequency shared locations in civilian public transit. Look for the entity with bridging calls and midpoint highway movement.

intermediaryCandidates.name: Person A (Ravi Kumar)
intermediaryCandidates.feedback: Incorrect. Person A is the coordinator of Group 1, not the intermediary bridge.

intermediaryCandidates.name: Person B (Contractor at Station)
intermediaryCandidates.feedback: False lead! You fell for the red-herring public railway station where 19 unrelated civilians pinged the same tower.

intermediaryCandidates.name: Person C (Ajay Singh)
intermediaryCandidates.feedback: Incorrect. Person C is the dispatch lead of Group 2, having no direct contact with Group 1.

intermediaryCandidates.name: Person D (Vikram 'Vicky' Rao)
intermediaryCandidates.feedback: CORRECT! Vikram Rao is the hidden intermediary bridging both groups via CDR #183 and Suryapet Toll Hub.
